title: 🔥 "IS 'ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED' A LIE?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IS 'ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED' A LIE?" 🚀🔥
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "For if we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
Many Christians today believe in the doctrine of "Once Saved, Always Saved" (OSAS)—the idea that once a person accepts Jesus, they can NEVER lose their salvation, no matter how they live.
But is this really what the Bible teaches?

Can a believer walk away from God, return to sin, and still be saved?
Or does the Bible warn about falling away and losing salvation?
🚨 The truth may shock you! Let’s dive into Scripture and expose the reality behind this doctrine.

🔥 1. CAN A CHRISTIAN LOSE THEIR SALVATION?
📖 2 Peter 2:20-21 – "For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first. For it would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than after knowing it to turn back."
🔥 Peter is clear: It is possible to be saved, then turn back to sin and be in a worse condition than before.
🚨 If OSAS is true, why does the Bible repeatedly warn believers about falling away?

🔥 2. WHAT DID JESUS SAY?
📖 John 15:5-6 – "I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in Me and I in you, you will bear much fruit… If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned."
🔥 Jesus says you must REMAIN in Him. If you don’t, you will be CUT OFF and burned.
✅ A believer must stay connected to Jesus—faith is not a one-time event but a lifelong commitment.
🚨 If "Once Saved, Always Saved" was true, why would Jesus warn about being cut off?

🔥 3. CAN YOU BE ERASED FROM THE BOOK OF LIFE?
📖 Revelation 3:5 – "The one who conquers will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the Book of Life."
🚨 This verse implies that some names CAN be blotted out!
🔥 If salvation was permanent no matter what, why would Jesus even mention this possibility?
📖 Exodus 32:33 – "The Lord said to Moses, ‘Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.’"
✅ Salvation is a gift—but you can forfeit it through rebellion and unbelief.

🔥 4. WARNING: YOU CAN FALL AWAY FROM THE FAITH!
📖 Hebrews 6:4-6 – "For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit… and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance."

🔥 This verse speaks of people who were:
✔️ Enlightened (understood the gospel).
✔️ Tasted the heavenly gift (experienced salvation).
✔️ Shared in the Holy Spirit (were truly saved).
✔️ Then fell away!
🚨 If OSAS was true, why does the Bible say some people fall away and cannot be restored?

🔥 5. WHAT ABOUT ‘NO ONE CAN SNATCH THEM FROM GOD’S HAND’ (JOHN 10:28)?
Many use this verse to defend OSAS:
📖 John 10:28 – "I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of My hand."

✅ This is true—Satan and others cannot steal you from God.
🚨 BUT IT DOESN’T SAY YOU CAN’T WALK AWAY!
🔥 God will never force you to stay if you choose to rebel.
📖 Luke 15:11-32 – The Prodigal Son willingly left the Father’s house. He was only restored when he REPENTED and returned!

🔥 6. FAITH REQUIRES ENDURANCE – NOT A ONE-TIME DECISION!
📖 Matthew 24:13 – "But the one who endures to the end will be saved."
✅ Salvation is not about how you START—it’s about how you FINISH.
🚨 If salvation was guaranteed, why does Jesus say we must ENDURE?
📖 Philippians 2:12 – "Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling."
🔥 Salvation is not a casual thing—it requires commitment, perseverance, and obedience.

🔥 7. HOW TO REMAIN IN CHRIST AND STAY SAVED!
📖 Hebrews 3:14 – "For we have come to share in Christ, IF indeed we hold our original confidence firm to the end."
🔥 Follow these steps to ensure you remain in Christ:

✅ Stay in the Word (Psalm 119:11)
✅ Keep a strong prayer life (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
✅ Repent quickly when you sin (1 John 1:9)
✅ Remain in fellowship with true believers (Hebrews 10:25)
✅ Endure persecution and trials for Christ (James 1:12)
🚨 Do NOT be deceived—salvation requires faithfulness to the end!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: SALVATION CAN BE LOST IF YOU ABANDON CHRIST!
✅ "Once Saved, Always Saved" is a dangerous false doctrine.
✅ The Bible warns about falling away, being cut off, and names being erased from the Book of Life.
✅ Salvation requires faithfulness, endurance, and obedience—not just a one-time prayer.
✅ No one can steal you from God’s hand, but you can walk away through rebellion and unbelief.
🚨 DON’T PLAY WITH YOUR SALVATION—STAY FAITHFUL TO JESUS UNTIL THE END!
